# Ecologist, data scientist, and many other things...

I'm interested in ecological dynamics — the mechanisms underlying change in ecosystems over time and space. I study resilience, thresholds, and interactions across ecological, climate, and social systems.

Now at the [Cary Institute of Ecosystem Studies](https://www.caryinstitute.org/science/research-support/quinn-asena) with Dr. Winslow Hansen in the [Forest Futures Lab](https://forestfutureslab.org/), investigating boreal forest dynamics under climate change and fire.
